gen-almendra-display-gf-numans: Ornate and bookish, Almendra Display keeps its letters open and its x-height tall. And Numans follows with a modern sans whose widely tracked, rope-thick lowercase lets a long passage move at a slow, steady stroll.
gen-audiowide-gf-onest: Audiowide sets tall, tile-like letters with no thick-thin shift, while Onest keeps short ascenders over big bowls. Its strength is a friendly, futuristic ease.
gen-fs-bonny-fs-plein: Refined and literary, Bonny holds modest stroke contrast in tight-set lines. Plein, a plain sans, gives each round letter a clear channel in, so it handles the reading itself.
gen-almendra-display-gf-open-sans: Open Sans brings smooth, bulky lowercase proportions with no clogged curves beneath Almendra Display's ornate heading. They sit together like a manuscript beside a modern page.
gen-fs-bonny-fs-amulya: Bonny's curves gape open with tame, never razor-thin contrast. Amulya, a sans with generous gaps in its curves, sits beneath it so the literary heading and modern text feel like one page.
gen-audiowide-gf-oxygen: Audiowide's glyphs sit like tiles with wide grout lines. Oxygen, a plain sans with lowercase nearly matching capitals, gives the pair its strongest quality: a futuristic look that stays friendly to read.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Dark, jagged and wide-spaced, Eater snarls with short ascenders over its moderate contrast. Noto Sans Nabataean, a plain sans with near cap-tall lowercase, is the pair's strongest quality: a calm answer to the menace.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Eater's slight pinch where curves meet stems gives it a dark, aggressive edge. Noto Sans Nag Mundari follows with half-unwrapped c and s shapes, and its lowercase rivals the capitals, so a larger heading suits it.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-newa: Eater's diagonals look gently pressed, thinner than its verticals, giving it a dark bite. But Noto Sans Newa, a plain sans, is built for reading, with a clearly open lowercase e and tall counters.
gen-fs-bonny-outfit: Bonny is a literary serif whose light modulation shows mainly up close. And Outfit, a plain sans, draws cable-like curves that finish before closing, so it carries the text.
